definitions.explanation: The small, specific elements or aspects of something, as opposed to the overall picture.

examples.japanese: {細部|さいぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧。
examples.english: To pay attention to the details.

examples.japanese: {細部|さいぶ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げられている→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: It has been carefully finished down to the finest details.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{細部|さいぶ}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{後日|ごじつ}→後日：12510_gojitsu⟧{改|あらた}めて⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせましょう→打ち合わせる：04228_uchiawaseru⟧。
examples.english: Let's discuss the details of the contract at a later date.

notes:
A somewhat formal word for details, composed of {細|さい} (fine/detailed) and ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part/section). Often used in contexts involving craftsmanship, design, planning, or analysis where precision matters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細部|さいぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to be particular about details
- {細部|さいぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって: covering every detail
- {細部|さいぶ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: down to the details
- {細部|さいぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧: to work out the details
- {細部|さいぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the details

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧: details, full particulars — more formal, often used for comprehensive information
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧: the small details — more conversational
- ⟦{些細|ささい}→些細：07160_sasai⟧な: trivial, minor — emphasizes insignificance rather than precision
